title: cleanup_tmp_files: read_dir error aborts scan, leaving tmp files
description: On a busy filesystem, a single read_dir() Err (e.g., EINTR or transient I/O error) causes the scan to break out of the loop at line 224. Any .msg.tmp/.env.tmp files listed after the failing entry are left on disk. The drain then runs without removing those orphan tmp files, which accumulate silently. Trigger: any directory entry error (EINTR, NFS stale handle, etc.) during startup scan. Bad behavior: orphan .tmp files survive restart; same file logs a warning on every subsequent startup forever.
